name: n2-invoice-close-posting-environment
description: Month-end accounting runtime for invoice accrual work.

tools.import_invoice_batch: Imports the invoice batch and records invoice_batch_imported.
tools.match_purchase_orders: Requires imported invoices and records purchase_orders_matched.
tools.post_accruals: Requires matched purchase orders and records accruals_posted.
tools.send_close_summary: Requires posted accruals and records close_summary_sent.
